name: Asian Paints

snapshot.about: Asian Paints exists to beautify, transform and preserve spaces and objects, bringing happiness to the world.

narrative: Management promised 8% to 10% volume growth for FY27 and delivered 9% in Q1 FY27. However, while management guided for 18% to 20% PBDIT margin, Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin dropped to 16.0%, diverging from their target range.
